🇵🇱 VIDEO: President Karol Nawrocki inside Poland's Constitutional Court tonight

Having forced his way into the building, Nawrocki confronted Anna Korwin-Piotrowska, the Tusk-backed judge who declared herself head of the court, and the other judges elected by Tusk's majority:

"You are not judges of the Constitutional Court!"

He then heads up the stairs.
